rationale: The analysis correctly identifies reduced consumer throughput, preserves both candidate mechanisms, notes that both changes were reverted together, and prioritizes discriminating rollback tests and separated timing/traces. It is slightly overconfident in claiming that at least one change caused the loss solely from the joint revert; it later acknowledges independent time-based recovery as possible. The proposed associations between each change and its log signal are appropriately low-confidence but remain plausible inferences beyond direct proof.
